offer.text: My little one wandered out and now it's dark. They can walk on their own legs — just guard them while they lead the way back to the village. Please, hurry.

accept.text: Stay between them and the shadows. I'll keep a lamp in the window.

decline.text: Please — don't leave them out there alone.

in_progress.text: Are they safe? Are they close? I can't bear the waiting.

ready.text: Is that— it's them! Home and whole!

complete.text: You watched over my child as if they were your own. I will never forget it.

failed.text: No... not my child. I can't speak of it. Leave me.
